notes.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die is Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]The wait is over - Lost in Random: The Eternal Die has officially launched on all platforms!
[/b]
Enter a dark new chapter set in the twisted world of Random. Play as Queen Aleksandra and roll alongside your living die, Fortune, as you face the corrupted designs of Mare the Knight in this roguelite fairytale adventure.

Watch the official launch trailer [url=https://youtu.be/5-7-UCz3HN8]right here[/url]: 

[previewyoutube=5-7-UCz3HN8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Play in Style with the Fortune Edition (Now Discounted!)
[/h2]
Kick off your journey with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1288786/]Fortune Edition[/url], [b]available at launch discount until July 10[/b]! The Fortune Edition includes:

[list]
[*] [b]Wardrobe Expansion[/b] - exclusive outfits to customise Aleksandra & Fortune
[*] [b]Digital Artbook + Soundtrack[/b] (Steam exclusive)
[/list]

[h2]Want the Full Story? We’ve Got You Covered
[/h2]
[h3]Lore Recap Video
[/h3]
Narrated by Senior Narrative Designer Oskar Hanska, this video catches you up on everything you need to know from the first game - perfect for newcomers or returning fans.

[b]Watch it [url=https://youtu.be/bXh_F6lMr0Q]here[/url].[/b]

[h3]10-Minute Gameplay Preview
[/h3]
See Queen Aleksandra and Fortune in action in our official gameplay walkthrough featuring exclusive dev commentary, combat, exploration, dice rolls, and more.

[b]Watch [url=https://youtu.be/vB811ZT-9is]here[/url].[/b]

[h3]Dev Diary Series
[/h3]
Meet the team behind The Eternal Die as they explore the game’s design, worldbuilding, eerie soundscapes, and twisted art direction across four bite-sized episodes.

[b]Watch them all [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpV2lLgjD0wvZxWNvES5uQeTaFeG3FNJb&feature=shared]here[/url].[/b]

--------------

Queen Aleksandra’s fight has begun - are you ready to roll the dice and take on Mare’s nightmares?

notes.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Advanced Access Now Open!

Pre-order the Fortune Edition today and be among the first to roll into this twisted new chapter of Random before the full launch on June 17 across all platforms.

Step into the shoes of Queen Aleksandra and wield your living die companion Fortune as you face Mare the Knight and his corrupted games in this dark fairytale roguelite inspired by the world of the original Lost in Random.

Pre-order the Fortune Edition to:
[list]
[*] Play now with Advanced Access
[*] Unlock bonus content exclusive to the Fortune Edition
[*] Join the first wave of players to explore Mare’s twisted realms
[/list]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1288786/]Pre-Order the Fortune Edition Now[/url][/b]

[h3]New to Random? Watch the Official Lore Recap!
[/h3]
Whether you’re new to the world of Random or just need a refresher, we’ve got you covered! [b][url=https://youtu.be/bXh_F6lMr0Q]Our official Lore Recap is now up on Youtube[/url][/b], narrated by Senior Narrative Designer and Writer Oskar Hanska.

Take a short trip through the story of the original game and discover the world, characters, and cursed kingdoms that led to the events of The Eternal Die.

[url=https://youtu.be/bXh_F6lMr0Q]Watch the full recap here[/url]:
[previewyoutube=bXh_F6lMr0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't miss your chance to roll early, explore the realms before anyone else, and see what fate has in store. Will you enter the Black Die?

[b]Lost in Random: The Eternal Die launches on June 17 – but the Fortune Edition opens the door today. Fortune favours the bold![/b]

notes.title: Steam Demo - Small Content Update
notes.content:
Hello Dice Wielders!

Thank you so much to everyone who has played our demo and shared their feedback and thoughts so far. Your support and engagement means the world to us!

Speaking of the demo, [b]we've just released a small content update to implement some quality of life changes.[/b] More info below:

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Vsync[/b]: is now enabled by default.
[*] [b]Roll Rooms[/b]: Added extra safety measures to avoid Fortune getting stuck when thrown
[*] [b]Relics & Spell Cards[/b]: has updated icon visuals
[*] [b]Map fast travel[/b]: Bug fixed where the player could get stuck when teleporting.
[/list]
If you haven't already, we'd love to hear your thoughts on the demo through our [b][url=https://forms.gle/SAkLtWwaFgVxz3ay9]official demo survey[/url][/b]. Your feedback helps us make the game even better and we couldn't be more thankful for all your support so far!

Let us know your thoughts and until then: happy gaming and may the odds be in your favour!

notes.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Official Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Have you tried the free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2564520/Lost_in_Random_The_Eternal_Die/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/lost-in-random-the-eternal-die/9n72g399183f/?utm_source=lir_website]Xbox[/url] demos of Lost in Random: The Eternal Die yet? If not, now’s the perfect time to dive in and get a first taste of what awaits you in The Eternal Die! And while you’re at it, don’t miss our brand-new [url=https://youtu.be/BsxC6L4k-kE]Gameplay Trailer[/url] for an exciting preview of the full experience launching in Summer 2025.

[previewyoutube=BsxC6L4k-kE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Embrace the Power of the Dice[/h3]
A true dice-wielder’s greatest weapon is, of course, their dice! Toss Fortune into battle to unleash devastating attacks and build powerful synergies using the all-new relic and ability systems. The possibilities are endless - but will luck be on your side? Roll for damage and see if the odds favour you!

[h3]Master Your Weapons[/h3]
Wield four distinct, fully upgradable weapons - each with its own unique fighting style:
[list]
[*] [b]Sword of Sixtopia[/b] - Agile and precise for quick strikes.
[*] [b]Helleven’s Hammer[/b] - Heavy and mighty for crushing blows.
[*] [b]Sevendipity Striker[/b] - Deadly and swift for high-impact combat.
[*] [b]Lance of Lady Luck[/b] - A piercing force with unmatched reach.
[/list]
Combine your weapons with relics, abilities, and Fortune itself to craft a playstyle that suits you best.

[h3]Even the Odds[/h3]
Leverage the brand-new colour-matching relic system to gain powerful buffs and upgrades during your runs. If you fall in battle, fear not! You’ll return to the Sanctuary, where you can purchase permanent upgrades, take on quests to uncover the mysteries of the Black Die, and even change up your wardrobe before your next attempt.

Along the way, you’ll meet helpful characters like Mannie Chex, whose shop is always full of useful surprises, and Wager Rollins, who offers high-stakes gambles that could lead to incredible rewards - or dire consequences.

[h3]Escape the Nightmare Realm[/h3]
Use your skills, wits, and a bit of luck to defeat the game’s formidable bosses - some of whom may look eerily familiar. Navigate the twisted realms of Random and prepare yourself for the ultimate showdown against the fearsome Knight the Mare. Do you have what it takes to take your vengeance?

[i]Get ready to roll the dice and shape your fate in Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - coming Summer 2025!
[/i]
